# Editing a test retries everything.
#
# A verdict says the tests caught a mutant. That stops being an answer about
# anything the moment those tests change, and nothing else in an action's
# identity notices: the template, the types it reads and the seed all sit
# still while an assertion is added, weakened or deleted.
#
# Without this, the run that proved a new test closed a gap was exactly the run
# that reported the gap still open.

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-missed.txt

# Nothing changed, so nothing is retried.
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-reused.txt

# Now assert on the value the mutation destroys.
cp covered.txt render_test.go
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-killed.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
-- covered.txt --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want-missed.txt --

  "greeting" templates.gohtml (complexity 1, dot: server.Page)
    MISS 1:29 action-zero

1 mutant, 0 killed, 1 missed, 0 skipped

    MISS 1:29 action-zero

-- want-killed.txt --
